name: Face Boundary Blend
algorithm: Face Boundary Blend — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes face-to-background boundary blending for deepfake detection following techniques from Face X-ray (Li et al., 2020):

1. **边界区域提取**: The transition zone between the face and surrounding context (hair, neck, ears, background) is extracted. This region — typically 10-30 pixels wide — is where deepfake blending artifacts are concentrated.

2. **AlphaMatte估计**: The effective alpha transparency at the face boundary is estimated. Natural faces don't have alpha boundaries — they transition organically to hair and neck. Deepfakes produce a detectable soft alpha matte where the generated face was composited, creating an unnatural transparency gradient.

3. **Cross-边界Feature分析**: Features on both sides of the boundary are compared: noise level, compression artifacts, color temperature, texture granularity, and local contrast. In authentic video, these features are continuous across the face boundary. In deepfakes, the separately generated face shows different characteristics than the original surrounding footage.

4. **边界Shape分析**: The shape of the blending region is analyzed. Deepfake systems typically use simple geometric templates (ellipses, convex hulls of landmarks) for face masks. These produce unnaturally regular boundary shapes compared to the organic boundaries of natural face-to-hair and face-to-neck transitions.

5. **Per-通道边界分析**: The blending boundary is analyzed independently in each color channel and in frequency domain. Even well-blended deepfakes may show boundary artifacts in specific channels — particularly in chroma channels where blending algorithms may be less sophisticated than in luminance.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through face boundary blend analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
